confirmed_frontend_findings: Orders currently retains one selected store ID without observing store epoch changes; late list/route/modal callbacks need captured current-view lifetime fences.

Orders list uses six local status values, four date ranges and four sort values against only the fetched page. Labels currently imply global totals and filtering. Preserve the original local predicates and calculations; label the loaded-page population honestly. Do not invent global search/counts or change API contracts.

Orders action/filter/header rows, fixed search height, rounded-to-whole-rupee amounts and narrow card rows need natural geometry and precise canonical formatting. Stress tests must establish actual failures before correction.
The Orders Settings menu is a no-op and needs an explicit supported disposition. Its route/owner has not yet been confirmed.

New draft order is a complex centered dialog; order detail refund/line-items/shipping tasks are also centered app forms and retain controllers beyond route exit. Use full-page editors for complex tasks and canonical short sheets for focused tracking/cancel/provider-reference choices.

Export status currently invites another attempt after a known queued job. Keep its existing five polls and same-ID recovery; use honest accepted/pending state and UI-local known-job readback through the existing API, without new persistence policy.

OrderService list failure may return its previous rows, and detail may return cache on error without an explicit freshness flag. This is a protected service contract; the frontend must not call cache a fresh confirmation. Current-store/record admission and unavailable recovery are presentation work; service freshness/persistence changes remain a separate dependency.

Order total helper falls back to line sums for non-positive totals; Return raw amount/status getters default to zero/requested. Preserve domain implementations. Inspect canonical response presence and use an honest unavailable/review state where the response does not establish the claimed value; do not silently redesign financial rules.

OrderDetail shipping form hardcodes a sandbox badge while the service can use configured providers. Mode must be represented from existing authority or marked unavailable; no provider configuration change.

Existing TwoFactorService capture/check, approval context and retained refund key/intent must stay exact through container changes. No real payment/refund/label/invitation side effects are authorized by this frontend task.

The shared rule-card semantics finding should be checked in other multi-control form cards before claiming native accessibility: a default Card may merge the editable node with the entire card. Do not apply a blind mechanical change to all record cards.

Active order list schema supports more query dimensions than OrderService exposes. New global filtering/search or trustworthy cache freshness would require the protected owner to expose the correct contract; label existing page-local behavior honestly and record that dependency.

Return normalization can omit an amount when there is no refund; the current Dart getter maps absence to zero. The frontend must inspect the existing raw response presence and distinguish unavailable from a real zero.
